visuals: A vast, arid landscape of the Gran Chaco region in Paraguay with sparse thorny trees and dry earth under a bright sun.
script: Now imagine this: two huge zones split by a river. The dry, wild Chaco stretches across the west.

visuals: Humid green plains and lush tropical forests in eastern Paraguay under a bright sun.
script: While humid plains and forests cover the greener east.

visuals: The wide Paraguay River winding through a landscape of both dense forests and dry plains.
script: The Paraguay River cuts through the whole country like nature’s highlighter pen. It shapes the land and even helps split the two main regions.

visuals: A powerful jaguar silently prowling through a dense forest in Paraguay.
script: The jaguar silently prowling in the forests.

visuals: A giant anteater with its long snout foraging in the dry grasslands of the Paraguayan Chaco.
script: And the giant anteater slurping up ants in the dry grasslands are rare but treasured creatures in Paraguay.

visuals: A white bare-throated bellbird with its distinct turquoise throat perched on a tree branch in Paraguay, calling loudly.
script: And have you heard of the bare-throated bellbird? This white-feathered wonder belts out one of the loudest bird calls on Earth. Bet no alarm clock can beat that!

visuals: The historic city center of Asunción, Paraguay, with its mix of colonial buildings and modern skyscrapers.
script: Now, can you guess the capital city? It’s Asunción, one of the oldest cities in all of South America. That's some serious history!

visuals: A busy street market in Ciudad del Este, Paraguay, with colorful stalls and many shoppers.
script: Ciudad del Este has a busy shopping district full of electronics and street vendors!

visuals: A lively street carnival in Encarnación, Paraguay, with people in colorful costumes dancing near the riverside beach.
script: While Encarnación throws lively carnivals by riverside beaches. Who’s ready to party by the water?

visuals: A quiet, historic street in the town of Yaguarón, Paraguay, with its famous colonial church and a few locals chatting.
script: Spanish and Guaraní are both spoken every day here. Guaraní's an Indigenous language, and kids even learn it in school!

visuals: A pleasant afternoon at the Plaza de Armas in Asunción, Paraguay, with pedestrians walking near the historic government buildings.
script: With around 7 million people, Paraguay’s population is about the same as the cities of Los Angeles and Chicago combined. So it’s cozy, not crowded.

visuals: A basket of fresh, golden chipa (cheesy corn bread) served on a traditional embroidered napkin in Paraguay.
script: Yum time! Breakfast wouldn’t be the same without chipa! A cheesy bread that goes great on road trips. Hungry yet?

visuals: A group of friends in a park in Paraguay sharing a cold tereré drink from a decorated cup with a metal straw (bombilla).
script: On a hot day, grab a tereré. It’s cold herbal tea sipped outdoors with friends, think of it like iced tea with magical herbs.

visuals: A traditional Paraguayan meal on a rustic table with grilled beef, boiled cassava, and corn-based dishes like sopa paraguaya.
script: Beef, cassava, and corn show up in tons of dishes. Farming is big here, and food is full of simple, hearty flavors.

visuals: Paraguayan musicians playing a traditional harp and guitars for dancers in colorful traditional outfits.
script: Music lovers, prepare to dance! Polka paraguaya, a lively style with guitars and harps, gets your feet moving!

visuals: Dancers in Paraguay performing the joyful galopa dance with balancing bottles on their heads and long flowing skirts.
script: The galopa is a joyful traditional dance still seen at festivals, bringing people together with music, colorful skirts, and big smiles that light up the celebration.

visuals: Paraguayan soccer star Roque Santa Cruz celebrating a goal in his national team jersey.
script: Soccer rules here! Roque Santa Cruz is a superstar known for skill and sportsmanship.

visuals: Paraguayan athlete Leryn Franco throwing a javelin during an international competition.
script: Leryn Franco is an Olympic javelin thrower from Paraguay.
